note: São Tomé and Príncipe: Togolese enter without a visa for 90 days and nationals of the countries listed for 15; Chinese get a 15-day visa on arrival; everyone else applies for an e-Visa (processed within 7 working days). Holders of a Schengen or US visa or residence, who may enter for 15 days without one, aren't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Migration and Borders Service's own notice (4 December 2025), which confirmed the 15-day list and Togo's 90 days, and by bilateral agreement gives Angola, Mozambique, Guinea-Bissau, Gabon and Rwanda 90 days (not 15), Cape Verde 60 (up to 120 a year, not modelled) and Ghana and South Africa 90, so those were changed or added. China's visa on arrival stands on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of São Tomé and Príncipe
sources.said: Visitors to São Tomé and Príncipe must obtain an e-Visa unless they are citizens from one of the visa-exempt countries or citizens who may obtain a visa on arrival. ... 90 days Togo 15 days All European Union member states Andorra Angola Brazil Canada Cape Verde Equatorial Guinea Gabon Guinea-Bissau Iceland Japan Kuwait Liechtenstein Monaco Morocco Mozambique Norway Qatar Russia Rwanda San Marino South Korea Switzerland Timor-Leste Turkey United Arab Emirates United Kingdom United States Vatican City ... Holders of ordinary passports issued by China may obtain a visa on arrival for 15 days. ... Citizens of countries ans territories that require a visa may obtain online through an e-VisaST system.
